summary: Repository-only fix for the packet-046 root cause. (1) Observation concurrency budget (hosted_workspace/bounded_observation.observation_budget): default 4, reserves >=2 host-executor connections for the control plane (HOSTED_EXECUTOR_CONNECTION_CAPACITY=8 mirror, HOSTED_CONTROL_PLANE_RESERVED_SLOTS=2, HOSTED_OBSERVATION_MAX_WORKERS=4); invariant 1<=effective<=capacity-reserved; excess observations QUEUED not dropped; fails closed to the safe range on invalid/zero/negative/>=capacity config. (2) Signed-transport error taxonomy (hosted_workspace/transport_errors): host_unreachable / host_connection_dropped_pre_response / host_http_error (integer status only) / host_transport_error + host_observation_capacity_deferred; SignedHostExecutor._send returns the specific secret-free code; is_host_unavailable_reason groups them (incl. legacy) for catch-all consumers. (3) Retry safety unchanged: consequential ops remain single-attempt fail-closed; a safe bounded retry limited to the pre-dispatch bare-close is recorded as a follow-up, not implemented. No migration. No deploy, no host contact, no flag armed, no authorization, no order. Does NOT change the host daemon's connection limit.

observation_budget.reserved_headroom_proof: effective(4) + reserved(2) = 6 <= capacity(8); >= 2 control-plane permits always free while observation runs at its maximum. Fail-closed clamps verified for 0/-3/8/999 and reserved>=capacity.
observation_budget.excess_handling: queued by the ThreadPool (every workspace observed within the cycle); none dropped; deferred = max(0, workspaces - effective) reported with reason host_observation_capacity_deferred.

transport_error_taxonomy.host_unreachable: connection refused / timeout / DNS / bare socket error — host not reached
transport_error_taxonomy.host_connection_dropped_pre_response: accepted then closed before any HTTP response (the daemon cap shutdown_request); labelled by observation, never inferred as capacity
transport_error_taxonomy.host_http_error: explicit non-2xx; integer http_status retained only (no body/token/url)
transport_error_taxonomy.host_transport_error: unclassified transport fault (still not the misleading host_unavailable)
transport_error_taxonomy.host_observation_capacity_deferred: backend-side observation-budget deferral metric (never a transport outcome)
transport_error_taxonomy.compatibility: is_host_unavailable_reason() groups all transport-failure codes incl. legacy host_unavailable; corroboration_diagnosis already routes any non-no_observer_task reason to OBSERVE_UNAVAILABLE (catch-all), so no consumer behaviour changes.

retry_decision: No automatic retry added to any consequential signed op (ACTIVATE/MODIFY/CLOSE/decommission): single-attempt, fail-closed, exactly one POST per step (verified: a raising transport is called exactly once). A safe bounded retry limited to host_connection_dropped_pre_response is recorded as a separate follow-up in ADR-0091, not implemented here.
